scripts.speaker: Dolangmal
scripts.text: Hey~! Hi human~ This is Mr. Dolangmal. kakaka~

scripts.speaker: Dolangmal
scripts.text: We are sent to here to take you to the heaven of cats, ^A2314BMalangdo^000000.

scripts.speaker: Dolangmal
scripts.text: How is that? The crowded city of Prontera is good, but why don't you go our heaven of the cats, ^A2314BMalangdo^000000?

scripts.speaker: Dolangmal
scripts.text: Why don't you go to ^A2314BMalangdo^000000? That place is better than Geffen, where there are only crowds of simple honest wizards.

scripts.speaker: Dolangmal
scripts.text: The fresh air of Payon is not bad, but why don't you go better place like the heaven of the cats, ^A2314BMalangdo^000000?

scripts.speaker: Dolangmal
scripts.text: {0}The beautiful and quiet place is better than Aldebaran, where it's so noisy with the tick-tock sound of the clock.

scripts.speaker: Dolangmal
scripts.text: Anyway, I got you. Whenever you want to go, just tell me.

scripts.speaker: Dolangmal
scripts.text: Ok! I like your attitude. Full of passion.

scripts.speaker: Dolangmal
scripts.text: Now, before you go ^A2314BMalangdo^000000, let me give you some warnings.

scripts.speaker: Dolangmal
scripts.text: First!! It is natural that when you arrive on ^A2314BMalangdo^000000, you should notify ^9E1837Admiral Tomas^000000 that you are here.

scripts.speaker: Dolangmal
scripts.text: If you don't do that, you might be attacked by scary and wild cats when you walk through dark streets.

scripts.speaker: Dolangmal
scripts.text: Secondly!! This ^A2314BMalangdo^000000 is absolutely our island of cats, even though we open to humans.

scripts.speaker: Dolangmal
scripts.text: We have a personality... no... no... respect us like one catality because we are cats.

scripts.speaker: Dolangmal
scripts.text: And the next one is...
Dolangmal proceeds and gives hundreds of warnings.

scripts.speaker: Dolangmal
scripts.text: Ok! Those are all the warnings!! They're easy and simple... right? Can you remember them?
Remember his warnings
Can't remember

scripts.speaker: Dolangmal
scripts.text: Ok! Do not bite two mice with one mouth. ^9E1837Admiral Tomas^000000 is located at the ^A2314Bcenter of the ship in Malangdo^000000.

scripts.speaker: Dolangmal
scripts.text: Don't forget to give him notice of your arrival.

scripts.speaker: Dolangmal
scripts.text: Alright. Let's go to the heaven of the cats, ^A2314BMalangdo^000000~

scripts.speaker: Dolangmal
scripts.text: What!? Can't you keep these easy rules? Chet!

scripts.speaker: Dolangmal
scripts.text: You're such an annoying guy. If you can't keep these, why didn't you tell me during our conversation? I told you everything... but..

scripts.speaker: Dolangmal
scripts.text: ^9E1837Admiral Tomas^000000 said to kidnap humans... No... Bring them politely?

scripts.speaker: Dolangmal
scripts.text: Anyway, I got you. Just tell me whenever you want to go.

scripts.text: I really want to send you there, but I can't because of the policy. It is difficult to send people who have visited ^A2314BMalangdo^000000 already.

scripts.speaker: Dolangmal
scripts.text: And that was roughly it... It's supposed to be rule 53...

scripts.speaker: Dolangmal
scripts.text: Actually, let me tell you rule 53. I am an indulgent cat.

scripts.speaker: Dolangmal
scripts.text: If you want to go back to ^A2314BMalangdo^000000, take the ship at Izlude or Alberta.

scripts.speaker: Dolangmal
scripts.text: If you enjoy that pleasant sea trip, you will arrive at the heaven of cats, ^A2314BMalangdo^000000.

scripts.speaker: Dolangmal
scripts.text: So easy! Isn't it? Well, good bye~

scripts.speaker: Dolangmal
